about.name: Coach Chris Stanley
about.title: OL
about.bio:
Coach Chris Stanley is a complete football mind with 7 years of experience on both sides of the ball at Union County HS. A rare coaching profile, Chris brings depth with expertise in Veer and Sho offensive systems and 335 defensive principles — giving athletes a holistic understanding of the game that most coaches simply can't offer.

Whether working with skill positions or defensive personnel, Coach Stanley brings an all-encompassing approach to player development that shows up on the scoreboard.

hero.headline: Union County HS's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Complete Football Development
services.description: A full-game coaching program covering both offensive concepts (Veer and Sho) and defensive principles (335). Perfect for athletes and coaches who want the complete picture.

services.title: Film Study & Game Planning
services.description: In-depth film breakdown on both sides of the ball — opponent tendencies, scheme adjustments, and game-week preparation.

services.title: Individual Skill Coaching
services.description: One-on-one sessions targeting your specific position needs, from technique to football IQ and mental reps.
